'''Casey's Meganium''' (Japanese: '''ナナコのメガニウム''' ''Nanako's Meganium'') is {{an|Casey}}'s [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]]. She obtained it as a Chikorita the day before {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}} arrived at [[Professor Elm]]'s lab.

==History==
==={{aniseries|GS}}===
[[File:Casey and Meganium.png|left|thumb|220px|Meganium and Casey]]
Meganium first appeared as a Chikorita alongside its Trainer in ''[[EP118|The Double Trouble Header]]''. It had just helped her to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} a {{p|Rattata}} when she met {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. She challenged Ash to a [[Pokémon battle]]. Ash defeated all three of her Pokémon including Chikorita with his {{AP|Charizard}}. Later, Casey used Chikorita again to battle [[Ash's Pikachu]] and, thanks to the [[type]] advantage, Chikorita was able to resist {{type|Electric}} attacks. The battle ended without a winner being declared, however, because {{TRT}} attacked both {{pkmn|Trainer}}s during the match and captured all of the Pokémon. In the end, Chikorita joined {{p|Pidgey}}, Rattata, and {{cat|Ash's Pokémon}} to send Team Rocket blasting off.

Chikorita reappeared in a flashback in ''[[EP126|The Chikorita Rescue]]''.

In ''[[EP161|The Bug Stops Here]]'', Chikorita was used during the [[Bug-Catching Contest]], despite having a disadvantage in the competition. Throughout the episode, Casey pushed Chikorita too hard and failed to notice when it became too tired to continue battling, forcing Ash, Misty, and Brock to call her out for this. When they were attacked by {{TRT}}, Casey used her Chikorita again, and during the battle, it [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{p|Bayleef}} and sent Team Rocket blasting off. Despite everything, Casey and Bayleef were unable to win the competition.

When Ash and {{ashfr}} met up with Casey again in ''[[EP261|Here's Lookin' at You, Elekid!]]'', her Bayleef was now fully evolved into a {{p|Meganium}}. During the search for [[Ash's Larvitar]], Meganium was one of the Pokémon affected by the power of [[James]]'s newly acquired {{p|Weepinbell}}. Casey used Meganium to defeat [[Jessie's Arbok]], but despite its efforts, it was no match for [[Jessie]]'s Pokémon. Later, Casey used Meganium in a battle against a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Elekid}}. Although Elekid was powerful, it was defeated by Meganium, allowing Casey to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} it.

===[[Pokémon Chronicles]]===

In ''[[HS11|A Date with Delcatty]]'', Meganium was beside Casey as she was trying to find out about a mysterious note that Misty received. Later, Meganium was used alongside [[Misty's Corsola]] in a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] against [[Butch]]'s {{p|Mightyena}} and [[Cassidy]]'s {{p|Sableye}}. Meganium and {{p|Corsola}} proved to be very powerful and easily defeated their opponents.

In ''[[HS17|Those Darn Electabuzz!]]'', Meganium joined [[Casey's Beedrill]] and {{p|Elekid}} to stop a runaway {{p|Charizard}} from advancing. Despite their strength, the trio couldn't keep the {{type|Fire}} Pokémon from away. Meganium later appeared with the other Pokémon to cheer on and help train [[Corey Demario]]'s own Pokémon.

==Personality and characteristics==
Meganium shares a close bond with Casey, often being seen [[Walking Pokémon|outside of its Poké Ball]]. It appears to share Casey's fighting spirit and enjoys her renditions of the Electabuzz fight song. Meganium is also a fierce battler, evolving into a Bayleef just so that it could help Casey during the [[Bug-Catching Contest]].
